meta.name: check-contribution
meta.description: Validates operator chart contribution practices (helm template, ct lint, docs generation) before committing changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交前自动校验 Helm chart 规范与文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护 Helm chart 并需要在提交前自动检查规范
copy.tagline_en: Automatically validate Helm chart conventions and docs before commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain Helm charts and need pre-commit validation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检查 Helm chart 的贡献规范：运行 helm template 验证模板、执行 ct lint 检查 lint 错误、运行 helm-docs 检查文档是否更新，并报告结果。
howto.when: 当你提交 Helm chart 变更前，要求 Claude 验证贡献规范时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查 operator chart 的贡献规范是否都通过了。
say.note: Claude 会运行三项检查并报告结果。

say.text: 验证 Helm 模板渲染和 chart lint 是否正常。
检查文档是否与 values.yaml 同步。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude validates Helm chart contribution practices: runs helm template to verify rendering, executes ct lint for linting errors, and runs helm-docs to check documentation freshness, then reports results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to validate contribution guidelines before committing Helm chart changes.

say_en.text: Check if the operator chart contribution practices are all passing.
say_en.note: Claude will run three checks and report results.

say_en.text: Verify Helm template rendering and chart linting.
say_en.note: Claude will run helm template and ct lint.

say_en.text: Check if documentation is in sync with values.yaml.
